description: STARS4Water publishes Ecological Risk due to Flow Alteration results for 14 East Anglia catchments using E-FLAG projected flows. Its public README explains the comparison of a 1989 to 2018 flow baseline with 2040 to 2059 and 2060 to 2079 futures. Twelve UKCP18 regional-climate ensemble members supply future flow scenarios. The deposited ZIP and TXT README are public under CC BY 4.0. Catchment modellers could compare these risk classes across climate members when setting abstraction or environmental-flow limits. This is distinct from the companion CS-N0W deposit, which covers 13 catchments and crosses two climate members with three abstraction pathways. The classes represent departures in flow-regime indicators, not direct measurements of ecological damage. E-FLAG input-flow rights and assumptions are separate from the Zenodo output label. The README was inspected but ZIP columns and individual catchment identifiers were not checked. No catalogue record explicitly names this release.
